cash-offers.summary: Most cash buyers start from what a house could sell for after repairs, then subtract the repairs, holding and resale costs, and their margin. That is why a cash offer usually comes in below a full retail listing. This video walks through that math, when a cash sale or a listing fits better, and a six-point checklist for comparing offers. With us, you get a fair cash offer in 24 hours, sell as-is with no repairs or fees, and close on your timeline.
